ELEMENTS.name: Pro-rata share accounting
ELEMENTS.def: Shares represent a proportional pool claim.

ELEMENTS.name: Index-based accrual
ELEMENTS.def: A global exchange-rate or debt index changes claim value.

ELEMENTS.name: Rebasing accounting
ELEMENTS.def: Nominal balances change through global scaling.

ELEMENTS.name: Constant-product invariant
ELEMENTS.def: x·y = k.

ELEMENTS.name: Weighted-geometric invariant
ELEMENTS.def: Multi-asset weighted pricing.

ELEMENTS.name: Stable-hybrid invariant
ELEMENTS.def: Constant-sum near parity, constant-product away from it.

ELEMENTS.name: Concentrated liquidity
ELEMENTS.def: Range-specific position state and tick activation.

ELEMENTS.name: Oracle-priced inventory curve
ELEMENTS.def: Proactive market making against an external reference.

ELEMENTS.name: Constant sum
ELEMENTS.def: Degenerate limit of St. Not an element and not an isotope — an isotope must preserve the failure family, and at parity break this pool is fully drainable on one side.

ELEMENTS.name: On-chain order book
ELEMENTS.def: Limit orders, sequencing, cancellation, settlement.

ELEMENTS.name: Request for quote
ELEMENTS.def: Signed maker quote against inventory.

ELEMENTS.name: Batch-auction clearing
ELEMENTS.def: Uniform clearing over a batch.

ELEMENTS.name: Intent & solver execution
ELEMENTS.def: Signed outcome constraints delegated to competing solvers.

ELEMENTS.name: Aggregation & routing
ELEMENTS.def: Multi-venue route construction.

ELEMENTS.name: Atomic flash liquidity
ELEMENTS.def: Borrow and repay within one settlement scope or revert.
ELEMENTS.note: The only async-impossible element. Anything sold as cross-chain flash is really Of+Rl+(Bs|Sl).

ELEMENTS.name: Pooled lending
ELEMENTS.def: Shared liquidity pool, many lenders and borrowers.

ELEMENTS.name: Isolated lending market
ELEMENTS.def: Per-market risk isolation with its own oracle, LLTV and rate model.

ELEMENTS.name: Collateralized-debt minting
ELEMENTS.def: Mint a liability against locked collateral.

ELEMENTS.name: Undercollateralized credit
ELEMENTS.def: Credit extended on identity, underwriting and recourse.

ELEMENTS.name: Fixed-term debt
ELEMENTS.def: Maturity-dated claim with a discount factor.

ELEMENTS.name: Collateral-threshold test
ELEMENTS.def: The margin/LTV/health computation and its threshold.

ELEMENTS.name: Incentivized liquidation
ELEMENTS.def: Third parties repay unhealthy debt for discounted collateral.

ELEMENTS.name: Auto-deleveraging
ELEMENTS.def: Rank-ordered forced close when buffers are exhausted.

ELEMENTS.name: Socialized-loss allocation
ELEMENTS.def: Losses assigned to an explicit claim class.

ELEMENTS.name: Staked backstop
ELEMENTS.def: Slashable first-loss capital.
ELEMENTS.note: Bs{trigger=non-fill} covers solver bonding — a separate element for it fails criterion F.

ELEMENTS.name: Perpetual funding transfer
ELEMENTS.def: Periodic payment tethering a perp to an index.

ELEMENTS.name: Option payoff
ELEMENTS.def: Strike, expiry, collateralized contingent settlement.

ELEMENTS.name: Tranche waterfall
ELEMENTS.def: Declared seniority over a determined loss event.

ELEMENTS.name: Mutual cover pool
ELEMENTS.def: Adjudicated claims against pooled premium capital.

ELEMENTS.name: Principal/yield separation
ELEMENTS.def: Split a yield-bearing claim into PT and YT.

ELEMENTS.name: Servicing & determination discretion
ELEMENTS.def: A named party's discretionary determination of loss, valuation, cure, waiver or suspension that alters others' claims.
ELEMENTS.note: Added after review: the table could not express what a waterfall does in a workout, as opposed to in the offering memorandum.

ELEMENTS.name: Directional position & hedge maintenance
ELEMENTS.def: A held directional exposure and the rebalancing that maintains it.
ELEMENTS.note: Added after review: decomposing a delta-neutral stablecoin left the short position itself as central residue — Pf is a funding transfer, not a position.

ELEMENTS.name: External data oracle
ELEMENTS.def: Imported off-chain value.

ELEMENTS.name: Time-weighted price
ELEMENTS.def: Cumulative-price accumulator over a window.

ELEMENTS.name: Optimistic assertion oracle
ELEMENTS.def: Assert-then-dispute escalation game.

ELEMENTS.name: Reserve / NAV attestation
ELEMENTS.def: A named party's statement about backing or value.

ELEMENTS.name: Streaming accrual
ELEMENTS.def: Continuous per-second transfer from escrow.

ELEMENTS.name: Epoch-gated transition
ELEMENTS.def: Snapshot, cutoff, rollover.

ELEMENTS.name: Withdrawal queue
ELEMENTS.def: Request now, claim later, against future asset availability.

ELEMENTS.name: Protocol-funded emissions
ELEMENTS.def: Newly issued tokens paid for measured actions.

ELEMENTS.name: Surplus & fee distribution
ELEMENTS.def: The rule naming the residual claimant of fees, spread and surplus.
ELEMENTS.note: Added after review: without it, adverse selection named on an informational bond has nowhere to land as a transfer rule.

ELEMENTS.name: Delayed-governance execution
ELEMENTS.def: A timelock between authorization and executability.

ELEMENTS.name: Mutable implementation proxy
ELEMENTS.def: Code replacement changes the reachable state machine.

ELEMENTS.name: Guardian or pause
ELEMENTS.def: Bounded suppression of reachable transitions.

ELEMENTS.name: Delegated execution scope
ELEMENTS.def: Persistent policy bounding the calls, assets, destinations, values, chains and time windows a delegate may reach.

ELEMENTS.name: Sponsored-fee liability
ELEMENTS.def: A conditional fee liability with metering and reimbursement.
ELEMENTS.note: Demoted from core: recurrence evidence thin, and the original name was written around an execution-model construct.

ELEMENTS.name: Cross-domain message verification
ELEMENTS.def: Decide whether a source-domain assertion is acceptable at the destination.

ELEMENTS.name: Cross-domain asset transfer
ELEMENTS.def: Create a destination claim against an explicit source debit.

ELEMENTS.name: Resource lock / reservation
ELEMENTS.def: Enforceable pre-commitment with exclusivity, expiry, fulfillment and release.

ELEMENTS.name: Optimistic fill & reimbursement
ELEMENTS.def: A filler advances destination value before finality and holds a contingent reimbursement claim.
ELEMENTS.note: The clean discriminator between a standard and a fast bridge transfer.

ELEMENTS.name: Direct redemption right
ELEMENTS.def: Redeem a liability against backing at a defined rate.

ELEMENTS.name: Peg-swap module
ELEMENTS.def: 1:1 reserve-backed swap with mint/burn authority.

ELEMENTS.name: Algorithmic supply adjustment
ELEMENTS.def: Supply expansion/contraction driven by measured price.

ELEMENTS.name: Permission / identity gate
ELEMENTS.def: Credential-checked eligibility.

ELEMENTS.name: Shielded-balance state
ELEMENTS.def: Commitments and nullifiers hide ownership.

ELEMENTS.name: Selective-disclosure proof
ELEMENTS.def: Prove a policy predicate without revealing the underlying credential.
ELEMENTS.note: Demoted from core: the finance-specificity gate applied to Zk applies here too, and was not applied symmetrically.

ELEMENTS.name: Freeze / forced transfer
ELEMENTS.def: Issuer- or authority-initiated immobilisation or reassignment of a holder claim without holder authorisation.
ELEMENTS.note: Added after review: without it the table cannot distinguish a bearer token from a registered security.

ELEMENTS.name: Restaking / shared security
ELEMENTS.def: Slashable capital reused to secure additional services.
ELEMENTS.note: Demoted from core: it sat in the core set while the register conceded its recurrence evidence was outstanding.

ELEMENTS.name: Staking & validator lifecycle
ELEMENTS.def: Delegation, activation, exit, reward accrual and penalty attribution for consensus-securing capital.
ELEMENTS.note: Added after review: decomposing a liquid-staking protocol left the entire staking mechanism as residue.

Fl* + manipulable Cp/Cl price + Pl/Cd, where manipulation cost < position value
Protocol token as collateral AND oracle market AND backstop
Rb into a balance-invariant ledger with no adapter
Illiquid backing + uncapped instant par redemption
Borrowable voting power + immediate execution
Cross-domain mint whose verifier is present but unproven correct
Shared collateral across nominally isolated markets
Up with immediate single-key control
Pm with a stale reference and unrestricted inventory
Uc with no Aw, At, collateral or reputation
Uc with all of them and weak underwriting
Lock-mint wrapped asset as canonical collateral whose value at risk exceeds the bridge's economic security
External-validator Xm securing value exceeding slashable stake

Unbounded delegated authority, or unlimited token approvals
Passive protocol-token reserve backing protocol-token collateral
Oa as sole truth for high-frequency liquidation
Restricted claim bridged via Xf into a representation with no destination-side Aw

LAWS.rule: (Pl|Im|Cd|Pf|Op) → (Ex|Tp|At) + Ct + (Li|Ad|Sl|Bs)
Pl → (Sh|Ix) + exit-liquidity
Uc → Aw + At{subject=borrower-financials} + (Bs|Tr) + obligor
Pf → Ex + Ct + Li + (Ad|Sl|Bs)
Py → (Sh|Ix|Rb) + Ep + Rd
Tr → (Sv | mechanical trigger) + declared seniority + dispute forum + recovery-timing assumption
Cd → Rd | Ps | liquidation capacity
Xf → Xm | named custodian, plus a global claim ledger
Xf → debit(source) = credit(destination)
Sb → proof verifier + nullifier set
Sd → credential source + verifier + revocation
In → signed constraints + settlement verifier + (solver|fallback) + timeout
Ex → freshness validation; Gp preferred for high-value obligations
illiquid backing → Wq | bounded liquidity reserve
Up → Tg | bounded emergency process
Aw → transfer-time enforcement where eligibility follows the holder
Au → bounded scope + revocation + expiry + nonce/domain separation
Xm → explicit finality + chain/domain binding + replay protection
Of → Xm + Xf + (Bs|Sl) + timeout
Rl → Au + single-spend + expiry + fulfillment proof + release
Gs → Au + metering + fee settlement
Rs → attributed slash condition + non-reflexive capital + loss waterfall
Sq → Xm + independent settlement finality
(In|Rf|Ba) → an explicit informational edge with a catalog tag
wrapped cross-domain collateral → haircut + cap + independent exit
Aw + Xf → destination-enforced eligibility + revocation propagation + jurisdictional binding
At → named attester + independence + stated assurance + staleness bound + recourse
Fz → named authority + enumerated triggers + appeal path + holder disclosure
(In|Ba|Rf|Of) → a declared surplus-allocation rule naming the residual claimant

SCREEN.label: Frame it
SCREEN.body: What assets are at stake, what are the trust boundaries, and what is the maximum loss if every trust assumption fails at once?

SCREEN.label: Implementation integrity
SCREEN.body: Reentrancy, callbacks, delegatecall, share inflation, rounding, storage layout, signature parsing, compiler and build provenance. This document does not check code.

SCREEN.label: Authority
SCREEN.body: Every Au, Up, Gp, Fz: scope bounded, revocation, expiry, domain separation. Enumerate the signer set and key concentration of every trust-bearing party, including Xm verifier sets.

SCREEN.label: Conservation & verification
SCREEN.body: Every fee, slippage, delay, loss and advance assigned to a named claim class. Every verifier proven correct, not merely present.

SCREEN.label: Leverage
SCREEN.body: Anything controlling more value than posted needs truth AND Ct AND a terminal loss path.

SCREEN.label: Truth manipulability
SCREEN.body: Price the manipulation against pool depth, not the attacker's balance.

SCREEN.label: Catalyst re-pricing
SCREEN.body: Re-price every economic and trust bond under zero-cost temporary capital and adversarial ordering.

SCREEN.label: Atomicity
SCREEN.body: Place every cross-domain step on the spectrum. Anything marketed atomic below same-transaction must name its repair bond.

SCREEN.label: Disclosure & surplus
SCREEN.body: Who observes the order before settlement, and who is the residual claimant?

SCREEN.label: Reflexivity
SCREEN.body: Does any element's price or solvency input read a market its own output dominates? Non-gating.

STRATA.desc: One settlement domain, no external fact.

STRATA.label: S2
STRATA.name: Measured or time-conditioned
STRATA.desc: External measurement or the passage of time.

STRATA.label: S4
STRATA.name: Multi-agent & cross-domain
STRATA.desc: Coordination across parties or trust boundaries.
